name: Full Smile
verdict: The biggest movement is a 66.67% drop in leads over the last 7 days, which drove CPL up 179.4% week-over-week, likely caused by reduced Meta delivery efficiency as spend only dipped 6.87% while lead volume collapsed. The top campaign "BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness" consumed $370.69 of the $699.98 28-day spend, and with 85 GHL opportunities created against 86 Meta-reported leads, counts are closely aligned, though 0 opportunities won signals a conversion or follow-up issue worth investigating.

performance.verdict: Lead collapse is real and worsening; 0-lead streak now 4 days, not noise.

findings.text: CPL spiked 179.4% week-over-week; last 3 days (Sep 12–14) show 0 leads on $38.94 spend Sep 14 — confirmed efficiency collapse, not a blip.
5 overdue milestones (oldest: Jul 23 renewal, latest: Aug 31 dashboard + scoreboard decision) unresolved; no completed event logged against any of them.
3-day signal (Sep 12–14): 0 leads, 0 GBP actions, $38.94 spend on Sep 14 only — all-channel stall vs prior 3 days (Sep 9–11) averaging 0.67 leads/day.
Spend flat (~$23/day avg) while leads collapsed from ~4.6/day (Aug 18–24) to 0/day (Sep 12–14) — classic creative fatigue pattern with no tracking change noted.
85 GHL opportunities created, 0 won, 0 appointments logged — leads arriving but pipeline conversion is zero; this is an intake/follow-up leak, not an ads problem.

suggestions.text: Inject at least 2 new creatives into BWS campaign; 4-day 0-lead streak on $370.69 28-day spend confirms fatigue.
suggestions.monday_update: The BWS - Instant Leads - Awareness campaign has produced 0 leads over the last 4 days (Sep 11–14) while spending ~$38.94 on Sep 14 alone, and CPL rose 179.4% week-over-week — a confirmed creative fatigue signal. Action: deploy a minimum of 2 new ad creatives into the BWS campaign by Sep 17. Success check: ≥3 leads in the 3 days following creative launch (by Sep 20), with CPL returning below the 28-day baseline of $8.14. If CPL stays above $20 by Sep 20, escalate to Sohib for budget review.

suggestions.text: Escalate 5 overdue SOW milestones to Sohib immediately; Aug scoreboard and dashboard are past-due and renewal trust is at risk.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones are overdue with no completion event recorded: renewal accountability (Jul 23), phone-match attribution (Aug 7), contact cleanup (Aug 14), dashboard live (Aug 31), and scoreboard trusted for renewal decision (Aug 31). This directly threatens the client's stay/walk decision, which they made explicit on 7/23. Action: Sohib to convene a same-week sync with Nacer to triage each item and assign hard-close dates. Success check: all 5 items have an owner and a close date logged in Monday by Sep 17.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake workflow; 85 opps created, 0 won, 0 appointments — confirmed follow-up or intake process leak, not an ads failure.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 85 opportunities created against 86 Meta leads in 28 days, yet 0 are won and 0 appointments are recorded — the leads are arriving but dying in the pipeline. This is the core of the client's complaint (<20 attributable new patients over 7–8 months). Action: Ahmed/Ali to pull the GHL pipeline stage breakdown and identify the drop-off stage by Sep 17; Lily sync to confirm whether leads are being contacted within 24 hours. Success check: at least 1 stage-level drop-off identified and a response protocol in place by Sep 19.
